h:
我想分享我的 Wan2.2 视频生成主力工作流程。由于许多人抱怨 Lighting LoRA 扰乱了输出视频动态 - 我决定添加一个额外的步骤，在将潜在视频传递到主“high_noise + low_noise”采样器之前启动没有任何 LoRA 的高噪声模型。
我通常不会启用帧插值和放大，但此工作流程中有 2 个可选步骤。

工作流程所需的 ComfyUI 自定义节点：

  • ComfyUI-WanVideoWrapper

  • ComfyUI 冲击包

  • rg三舒适

  • ComfyUI-易于使用

  • ComfyUI-VideoHelperSuite

  • ComfyUI_essentials

  • ComfyUI-帧插值

  • ComfyUI-VideoUpscale_WithModel

o.en:
I'd like to share my workhorse workflow for Wan2.2 video generation. Since many people complained about Lighting LoRA messing with output video dynamics - I decided to include an additional step that launches a high-noise model without any LoRA before passing the latent video to the main "high_noise + low_noise" sampler.
I don't usually enable frame interpolation and upscaling but there are 2 optional steps in this workflow for that.

Required ComfyUI custom nodes for the workflow:

  • ComfyUI-WanVideoWrapper

  • ComfyUI-Impact-Pack

  • rgthree-comfy

  • ComfyUI-Easy-Use

  • ComfyUI-VideoHelperSuite

  • ComfyUI_essentials

  • ComfyUI-Frame-Interpolation

  • ComfyUI-VideoUpscale_WithModel
